# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a mechanically faithful mobile portrait canvas boss-action game as **Auror Academy: Midnight Trial**. The player is a chosen first-year wizard exploring a cozy gothic castle corridor during a secret midnight class trial. Preserve the source mechanics exactly: joystick movement, collision obstacles, summon delay, boss spawn, attack button, parry button, boss chase/slash/projectile AI, HP bars, damage, stun, win/loss/restart. Transform presentation through wizard-school semantics: Expelliarmus attack, Protego parry, house courage meter, forbidden mentor boss, floating candles, enchanted bookcases, classmates, castle arches, house crests, magical particles, and mobile-first readable HUD. Use browser-native Canvas/CSS/JS with approved catalog fonts and audio only.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
The preserved source is a mobile portrait canvas action game with MENU, ROAM, SUMMONING, BOSS, WIN, and OVER states. The player uses a left virtual joystick, a summon/exam button, an attack button, and a parry button. Numeric mechanics preserved: player HP 300, boss HP 1500, player speed 6, attack timer 15, parry active 25 frames, parry cooldown 60 frames, boss chase speed 3.5, slash range/timing, projectile speed/life, collision rectangles, damage, knockback, win, loss, and restart semantics.

## Remix Target
Harry Potter wizard-school adventure with magical classes, chosen-one wonder, castle exploration, friendship trials, spell mastery, house identity, cozy gothic fantasy, and portrait mobile-first UX.

## Protected Mechanics
Movement, joystick input, rectangular obstacle collision, summon delay, boss spawn offset, boss chase/slash/projectile AI, attack hit range and damage, parry block/stun behavior, player/boss HP, win/loss/restart flow, canvas loop, and mobile touch action paths.

## Safe Transformation Surfaces
Title, HUD language, button labels, color roles, canvas entity shapes, castle background motifs, NPC/friend presentation, particles, GIF/audio feedback naming, fonts, overlays, progression framing, and copy.

identity.title: Auror Academy: Midnight Trial
identity.identity: A chosen first-year wizard survives a secret midnight spell-mastery exam inside a cozy gothic castle school.
identity.core_loop: Explore the castle corridor, open the exam seal, dodge or parry the forbidden mentor, cast close-range spells, deplete the mentor ward, and retry or celebrate mastery.
